panel.tip: Tip: draw a rectangle, select it and then start “Terrain” – the terrain takes over its size and position. Or create one here:
panel.brushHint: Hold the mouse button = keeps working · Shift swaps raise/lower · [ ] size · Ctrl+Z last stroke
panel.undoTitle: Take back the last brush stroke (Ctrl+Z)
panel.skirt: Earth base (side walls down below the deepest valley)
panel.applyTitle: Add to the model as a group (Enter) – editable later with a right-click

modes.flattenTip: Level to the height of the clicked point (building plot, plateau)

tool.start: Terrain: select a rectangle or create a new terrain in the window.
tool.sculpt: {mode} – hold the mouse button and drag · Shift: invert · [ ] brush size · Ctrl+Z: undo stroke · Enter/Esc: apply

session.needsFlatFace: Terrain only works from a horizontal face – e.g. a rectangle on the ground.

plugin.name: Terrain (sandbox)
plugin.description: Sculpt landscapes with a brush – raise, lower, smooth, flatten, roughen; grass, earth, rock and snow by height and slope, plus water. Brings s3d.terrain() for scripts.
plugin.apiDescription: Landscape with hills and mountains. Grass on flat ground, earth on slopes, rock at the top, optional snow and water. hills = mountain height (0 = flat). Can be sculpted further with the terrain tool.
